detail.title: 2MP 25 Starlight TiOC Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD4E225MB-HNR-A-PV1 2MP 25 Starlight TiOC Network PTZ Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 2MP Resolution • 25× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Active Deterrence: Instant Sound and Light Alerts Deter Intruders & Reduce Incidents • Smart Dual Light: Expansive Night View with up to 100m IR Distance and 50m White Light • WizTracking：Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • Built-in Dual Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • AcuPick Enables Fast and Precise Human&Vehicle Search • IP67 & TVS 6000V Protection with Lightning/Surge/Voltage Transient Resistance Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE); 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE); 0 lux (illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: 100 m (328.08 ft) (IR); 50 m (164.04 ft) (Dual Light Fusion-white light only); 50 m (164.04 ft) (Dual Light Fusion-IR light only);
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –15° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; linkage tracking
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, optimization, capturing pictures, uploading high-quality face snapshots and enhancing face images. Attribute Extraction is also supported, where 6 attributes and 8 expressions can be detected. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing, quality first, and selecting a preferred image among a group of snapshots.
General.AcuPick: Uses deep learning algorithms and works with back-end devices to accurately match targets, such as people and motor vehicles, and search through live and recorded videos to quickly locate targets.
General.Auto Patrol: After an IVS event occurs, the PTZ camera immediately initiates automated patrol of predefined key points to quickly cover potential risk areas and detect unknown threats in real time.
General.Light Warning: Red-blue light warning Flash duration: 5 s–30 s Flash frequency: high, medium, low
General.Sound Warning: Offers 11 types of sound alarms, and supports importing custom sound alarms.
General.Video Compression: MJPEG(Sub Stream 1);Smart H.265+; H.264H; Smart H.264+; H.265; H.264B; H.264
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 1080p/1.3M/720p@(1–50/60 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF@(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p/@(1–25/30 fps)
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 32 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view; Multiple colors available
General.Network Protocol: SSL; IGMP; DDNS; SMB; Bonjour; UDP; PPPoE; ARP; HTTPS; RTSP; SMTP; IPv4; RTP; IPv6; NTP; TCP/IP; DNS; RTCP; 802.1x;HTTP; RTMP; FTP; DHCP; NFS; UPnP; SNMP; ICMP; QoS
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T & Profile M); P2P; SDK; CGI
General.Storage: Micro SD card (512 GB); FTP/SFTP; NAS
General.Browser: IE 9 and later versions; Chrome 41 and later versions; Firefox 50 and later versions; Safari 10 and later versions
General.Certifications: CE: EN55032/EN55024/EN50130-4 FCC: Part15 subpartB, ANSI C63.4-2014
General.Audio Input: 1 channel (LINE IN, bare wire,built-in mic (mutually exclusive)
General.Alarm Input: 2 channels in: supports wet contact connection (max load 5 mA 3–5 VDC); supports dry contact connection
General.Alarm Output: 1 channel out: dry contact, max load 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; recording; send email; preset; tour; pattern; alarm digital output; audio
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Power Consumption: 12 VDC: Basic: 7 W; Max: 15.5 W (white light+heated glass+PTZ on+alarm+red and blue light flashing)"
General.Protection: IP67; TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
